description: Get current pump fuel prices in Turkey in TRY per litre, aggregated from official EPDK (Energy Market Regulatory Authority) per-brand reports. Covers gasoline 95 octane ('benzin95') and diesel ('motorin') with city averages plus min/max across brands. Available cities: istanbul, ankara, izmir, antalya. Pass 'city' to get one city, or omit it to compare all four. Refreshed every 6 hours. Use this for 'petrol price in Istanbul', 'diesel cost Turkey', 'benzin fiyatı'.

city.description: Optional city filter. One of: istanbul, ankara, izmir, antalya. Omit to get all four cities for comparison.

name: get_fuel_prices
title: Turkey Fuel Pump Prices
